YOUR PRIVATE WORKSPACE

Welcome to PV Info

Sign in with your user ID and password. No real name is needed.

Existing accounts can use their account email as the user ID until an alias is saved. This sends no email.

New users choose their own password at signup, then sign in to view approval status and messages. Existing accounts can also use an email sign-in link.

Choose your permanent password

A temporary password cannot open your workspace. Use a different password with 12–72 characters.

Forgot password? Use your recovery key

Lost both your password and recovery key?

An assistance request cannot authorize a password reset. The administrator must verify your identity separately. No automatic email is sent.

Sign in by email instead

Email delivery is limited to 2 requests per hour on the current provider. Password login uses no email quota. Use the newest sign-in email and avoid repeated requests.

Your team

A team shares one review queue: when anyone assesses, assigns or dismisses an update, everyone in the team sees it, and every change is kept in an audit trail. Saved and followed updates stay personal.

Your sign-in and team data are kept in PV Info's database. Only your team can see its queue; only you can see your own workspace.
